title: A Day with Anna, a Nurse
text:
Today we talk to Anna, a nurse at a small hospital. Anna says she always wanted to help sick people. When she was a child, her grandmother was ill, and the nurses were very kind to her. Anna decided to study nursing after that. She says the job is hard, but it makes her happy.

Anna works night shifts, so she often sleeps during the day. She says her family helps her a lot. Her husband cooks dinner on her working days. When she is not working, she likes to walk in the park with her dog. She says her best advice for new nurses is to be patient.

questions.text: Why did Anna decide to study nursing?
options: Her grandmother was ill and the nurses were kind to her
She wanted to become a teacher
Her husband asked her to do it
She won a prize at school

questions.text: What does Anna like to do when she is not working?
options: Walk in the park with her dog

questions.text: What can you infer about Anna's job?
options: It is tiring, but she enjoys it
She does not like helping people
She works only during the day

questions.text: Why does Anna's family help her a lot?
options: They understand that her work is hard
They want her to change jobs
They do not like her job
They live far away from her

vocabulary.definition: a person whose job is to care for sick people in a hospital
periods of time when a person works
able to wait calmly without getting annoyed

paragraph_translations: Dziś rozmawiamy z Anną, pielęgniarką w małym szpitalu. Anna mówi, że zawsze chciała pomagać chorym ludziom. Kiedy była dzieckiem, jej babcia chorowała, a pielęgniarki były dla niej bardzo miłe. Anna zdecydowała się potem studiować pielęgniarstwo. Mówi, że ta praca jest trudna, ale sprawia jej radość.

Anna pracuje na nocne zmiany, więc często śpi w ciągu dnia. Mówi, że jej rodzina bardzo jej pomaga. Jej mąż gotuje obiad w dni, kiedy ona pracuje. Kiedy nie pracuje, lubi spacerować z psem po parku. Mówi, że jej najlepszą radą dla nowych pielęgniarek jest cierpliwość.
